title: The Wheel of Fortune to Temperance: tarot card meanings
description: Tarot card meanings for the Wheel of Fortune, Justice, The Hanged Man, Death and Temperance (X to XIV), upright and reversed, with spread reading notes.

scenes.headline: The Wheel of Fortune to Temperance: tarot card meanings
scenes.caption: Major arcana X to XIV cover turning points, fairness, pause, endings and balance. Here is what each tarot card traditionally means, upright and reversed.
scenes.vo: Major arcana X to XIV cover turning points, fairness, pause, endings and balance. Here is what each tarot card traditionally means, upright and reversed.

scenes.headline: The Wheel of Fortune
scenes.caption: The RWS card shows a large wheel in the sky, with a sphinx on top and four winged figures in the corners.
scenes.vo: The Wheel of Fortune. The RWS card shows a large wheel in the sky, with a sphinx on top and four winged figures in the corners.

scenes.headline: Justice
scenes.caption: A seated figure holds scales in one hand and a raised sword in the other. Fairness, truth, cause and effect, accountability.
scenes.vo: Justice. A seated figure holds scales in one hand and a raised sword in the other. Fairness, truth, cause and effect, accountability.
